summary: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the parking regulations be amended on Sackville Street and Amelia Street. The proposed amendments will provide short-term parking to accommodate pick-up and drop-off activity for the proposed daycare at 459-461 Sackville Street. These parking amendments will also help deter double sided parking on the sides of the streets abutting this property during pick-up and drop-off hours of operation.
decided: The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Sackville Street, between Gerrard Street East and the north end, to be in effect between Gerrard Street East and a point 20 metres south of Amelia Street, and between Amelia Street and the north end of Sackville Street. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east side of Sackville Street, between Amelia Street and a point 20 metres south. 3. Amended the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Amelia Street, between Parliament Street and a point 45.7 metres east of Sumach Street, to be in effect between Parliament Street and Sackville Street, and between a point 27 metres east of Sackville Street and a point 45.7 metres east of Sumach Street. 4. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Amelia Street, between Sackville Street and a point 27 metres east. 5. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes, from 7:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Sackville Street, between a point 7 metres south of Amelia Street and a point 5.5 metres further south. 6. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes, from 7:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Amelia Street, between a point 10.5 metres east of…
